name: AR-2 Coyote
notes: Sets enemies on fire. Falloff values are unknown.

name: AR-23 Liberator
notes: Equipped with drum magazine.

name: AR-23A Liberator Carbine
notes: Equipped with drum magazine.

name: AR-23P Liberator Penetrator
notes: Equipped with drum magazine.

name: AR-32 Pacifier
notes: Applies medium stun (3s).

name: ARC-12 Blitzer
notes: Applies small stun (1.5s). You can change the number of simulated arcs (pellets) by modifying the override parameter (default = 5 pellets). It is not possible to precisely control what the arcs will aim at. Electric damage is doubled against Fleshmobs.

name: JAR-5 Dominator
notes: Falloff values are unknown.

name: LAS-16 Sickle
notes: Cools [12% cold / 8% normal / 6% hot] per second. You need to reload if you overheat the coil. The fire effect simulation does not take into account the accumulation time of the status (generally 0.75-2s). The TTK value displayed may be slightly shorter than the one observed in game.

name: LAS-17 Double-Edge Sickle (0-25%)
notes: Cools [6% cold / 4% normal / 3% hot] per second. 25% heat is equivalent to 41 shots.

name: LAS-17 Double-Edge Sickle (26-50%)
notes: Cools [6% cold / 4% normal / 3% hot] per second. 50% heat is equivalent to 82 shots. Deals 10 HP/s to players (negated by vitality bonus + inflammable armor passive).

name: LAS-17 Double-Edge Sickle (51-90%)
notes: Cools [6% cold / 4% normal / 3% hot] per second. 90% heat is equivalent to 148 shots. Deals 20 HP/s to players (mitigated by vitality bonus + inflammable armor passive).

name: LAS-17 Double-Edge Sickle (91-100%)
notes: Cools [6% cold / 4% normal / 3% hot] per second. 100% heat is equivalent to 164+ shots. Deals 50 HP/s to players + burns (slowed by vitality bonus + inflammable armor passive). Does not need to be reloaded once overheated.

name: LAS-5 Scythe
notes: Sets enemies on fire. Mag size is how long you can fire before overheating. Cools [12.75% cold / 8.5% normal / 6.37% hot] per second.

name: M7S SMG
notes: Falloff values are outdated. Reload speed values are temporary. The M7S SMG is the only primary weapon to have access to a suppressor.

name: M90A Shotgun
notes: You can change the number of simulated pellets by modifying the override parameter (default = 11 pellets). Reload speed values are temporary.

name: MP-98 Knight
notes: Equipped with extended magazine. Falloff values are outdated : 1.003.000 increased Drag factor from 30% to 60%.

name: PLAS-1 Scorcher
notes: The explosion can penetrate medium armor but the plasma projectile has only light armor penetration.

name: PLAS-101 Purifier (charged)
notes: Maximum charge of 1 sec gives a 100% damage multiplier. The explosion doesn’t scale but a fully charged shot has a bigger blast radius and higher damage.

name: PLAS-101 Purifier (uncharged)
notes: Minimum charge of 0.1 sec gives a 50% damage multiplier. The explosion doesn’t scale but a fully charged shot has a bigger blast radius and higher damage.

name: PLAS-39 Accelerator Rifle
notes: Each burst fires 3 shots. The BTK result refers to the number of projectiles that must hit the target, not the number of bursts. Falloff values are unkown.

name: R-2 Amendment
notes: Falloff values are temporary.

name: R-36 Eruptor
notes: Maximum range 180m. Each shot scatters 30 shrapnel in all directions. The number of shrapnel that will hit the targeted area can vary greatly depending on the size of the enemy. You can choose how much shrapnel is simulated via the override parameter (default = 0 shrapnel).

name: SG-20 Halt (flechette)
notes: You can change the number of simulated pellets by modifying the override parameter (default = 11 pellets).

name: SG-20 Halt (stun)
notes: Applies large stun (5s). You can change the number of simulated pellets by modifying the override parameter (default = 20 pellets).

name: SG-225 Breaker
notes: Equipped with drum magazine. You can change the number of simulated pellets by modifying the override parameter (default = 11 pellets).

name: SG-225SP Breaker Spray & Pray
notes: You can change the number of simulated pellets by modifying the override parameter (default = 16 pellets).

name: SG-451 Cookout
notes: You can change the number of simulated pellets and activate/deactivate DoT fire simulation by modifying the override parameters (default = 20 pellets).

name: SG-8 Punisher

name: VG-70 Variable (volley)

name: GP-31 Ultimatum

name: P-72 Crisper
notes: Average value of 5m spray damage. Peaks at about 240/s, goes as low as 130/s. Damage will be lower if the target is further away. Enemies have damage multipliers that change this value (not displayed but taken into account in calculations). Sourced by Exhillious.

name: P-92 Warrant
notes: Toggleable guided mode. Can lock targets up to ~50m. Falloff values are temporary.

name: SG-22 Bushwhacker (triple shot)

name: AC-8 Autocannon FLAK
notes: Flak shells are proximity-triggered. Most of the time, the projectile will denotate before hitting the target. Each shot scatters 30 shrapnel. The number of shards that will hit the targeted area can vary depending on the size of the enemy. You can choose how much shrapnel is simulated via the override parameter (default = 0 shrapnel).

name: ARC-3 Arc Thrower
notes: Applies small stun (1.5s). Electric damage is doubled against Fleshmobs.

name: EAT-700 Expendable Napalm (WIP)
notes: WIP.

name: FAF-14 Spear
notes: Each shot behaves as a Stun grenade (medium stun) and creates 10 arcs (small stun). You can change the number of simulated arcs by modifying the override parameter (default = 0 arcs). It is not possible to precisely control what the arcs will aim at.

name: GL-21 Grenade Launcher
notes: The fuse has a range safety that prevents it from detonating too close to the wielder.

name: GL-52 De-Escalator
notes: Each shot behaves as a Stun grenade (large stun, 5s) and creates 10 arcs (small stun, 1.5s). You can change the number of simulated arcs by modifying the override parameter (default = 0 arcs). It is not possible to precisely control what the arcs will aim at. Electric damage is doubled against Fleshmobs.

name: GR-8 Recoilless Rifle AT
notes: The weapon is considered fully reloaded when its icon in the HUD changes from red to white. Timing the animation cancel can be tricky but rewarding.

name: GR-8 Recoilless Rifle HE
notes: The weapon is considered fully reloaded when its icon in the HUD changes from red to white. Timing the animation cancel can be tricky but rewarding.

name: RL-77 Airburst Rocket Launcher (bomblet)
notes: Each rocket is proximity-detonated and spreads 25 bombs over a wide radius. It is impossible to target a specific enemy part with this weapon. The values shown here are optimal and do not necessarily represent the results obtained in game.

name: RS-422 Railgun
notes: Charging the weapon in unsafe (0.5 to 3s) mode linearily increases the damage dealt by up to 150%. Explodes if a charge is held for more than 3s.

name: S-11 Speargun
notes: These projectiles release a cloud of gas on impact (r2/5/7m). Maximum range of 510m. Falloff values are unknown.

name: SG-88 Break-Action Shotgun
notes: You can change the number of simulated pellets by modifying the override parameter (default = 9 pellets).

name: StA-X3 WASP Launcher
notes: The W.A.S.P can lock onto targets up to 300m away. It is impossible to target a specific enemy part with this weapon. The values shown here are optimal and do not necessarily represent the results obtained in game.
